svg.text: JAX/XLA Latent Diffusion Reference - AI-Hypercomputer/maxdiffusion - TPU Pod scale train + infer
L1 - Supported Models + Workflows (Diffusers fork - HF JAX weight compatible)
L2 - YAML Config + Entry Scripts (declarative control plane - CLI overrides)
XPK workload create - multihost TPU VM ssh
L3 - Model Components (modular pipeline - U-Net / DiT / VAE / encoders / schedulers)
ControlNet side branches for SD1.4 + SDXL
Latent space encode/decode for all models
HF Hub weight load w/ from_pt=True
CFG Cache: skip uncond branch + FFT comp
Mutually exclusive - one cache at a time
Predict delta via norm + timestep sensitivity
Multi-LoRA loading for SDXL + Flux + Wan
Euler Discrete default for most models
Flow matching for Flux + Wan pipelines
L4 - Attention Backends (hardware-specific kernels - selectable via attention= YAML)
Transformer Engine fused attention on CUDA
Distributed attention for long video seq
L5 - 4D Device Mesh + Parallelism (JAX GSPMD sharding - ICI within pod / DCN across pods)
logical_axis_rules map dims to mesh axes
Auto-shard with -1 on one axis only
Lower bandwidth - best for data parallel
Wan: context + head TP - fractional batch
Train: DP first - Infer: FSDP for big models
L6 - Data Pipeline + Memory Optimization (TFRecords - Grain - remat - mixed precision)
YAML-driven end-to-end - same config system for train and generate
Step 1: Dataset prep - TFRecords / HF Hub - optional latent+TE cache preprocessing
Step 2: Load base_*.yml - set mesh sharding + attention + dtype + parallelism axes
Step 3: JIT init model - Orbax load or from_pt HF weights - shard params on mesh
Step 4: Train loop or denoise loop - flash attn - optional SenCache/CFG cache skip
Step 5: Orbax checkpoint to GCS - generate_* decode latents via VAE - export Diffusers fmt
Scale path: single TPU host - multihost VM - XPK pod workload (v5p-256 Wan training)
Flux schnell v6e-4: 4 steps in 0.8s - Wan 720p 81 frames w/ context parallel + flash
Diffusers fork evolved for TPU Pod scale - not a PyTorch serving stack
Production target: Cloud TPU v5p/v6e - GPU support community-maintained
Design Position (JAX/XLA diffusion reference for TPU Pods - fork Diffusers for scale not simplicity)
4D mesh sharding + Pallas flash + Orbax checkpoints + HF weight bridge = research-to-production DiT on TPU
Init: YAML config + mesh - JIT model init - Orbax or from_pt load - shard on ici/dcn axes
Loop: encode prompt - denoise w/ scheduler - optional cache skip - VAE decode - GCS checkpoint/metrics
